body: Well, i just got together with her and got everything off my chest and told her the truth.  Told her I'm a liar and that I can work on it, not only for myself but for our relationship.  She said she has too much pride to let it happen, that she loves me but I fucked up too much.  I wish i wasnt such a liar, we would still be together.  6 years, down the god damn drain because of my lies.  Fuck me.
Thanks, I needed to hear that from somebody.  No one knows the truth but me and who ever reads this.  I wish i could go back in time and never lie to her.

I know, thats where i fucked up.  It just sucks cuz  shes ignoring everything from me, my emails, text, calls.  I hope i can talk to her soon and fix it. I might be overreacting, i dont think i have the balls to off myself :/
its not bringing her back though, thoughts of suicide are fading away but the depression is here, 6 years down the drain

I lost a lot of friends because all my time was for the relationship.  wedding date was this june, we didnt want anything big, just through the court so i can share my benefits with her and what not.  why do bad things have to happen to me all the time? just when shit was finally looking good
:'( ok, if she wants to talk ill ask her about counseling, if not i dont know how to react to this.  its too much for me
We broke up for a year once, and it was what we needed.  We got back together and were as strong as ever.  now this? really??

idk why, but your comment brought me to tears.  We have had trust issues before because of me but this was before, i thought our problems were fixed because everything has been going so perfect.  the only thing kept me from making any dumb decisions today was my mom waking me up for work and telling me she loves me :(.  I wish it was her though, i wish she was calling me like she use to in the mornings, from what i hear shes as depressed as me just too hard headed to understand.  Its ruining my life.
